description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Use when the owner wants to add, remove or reprice services or items (for example, raise a price). Replace the whole catalog with what the owner approved. Read service_setup first and pass catalog.revision. Items (in categories) have a price (priceCents, pricing fixed/from/confirm, unit), durationMinutes (appointments; null when unknown), fulfillment (appointment, reservation, pickup, delivery, onsite, request, or elsewhere alone: bought on its own page, so productUrl is required and it is never booked or ordered here), options (option group ids, optionally only some choices), fields, group/excludes rules, availability and productUrl (optional https link to the item's page on the business's own website). optionGroups have min/max and choices (priceCents added, or sets: true to set the price, like a size; excludes). fulfillment settings: pickup, delivery (feeCents, minimumCents, zips). Keep existing ids.
name: update_catalog
title: Update my catalog
